summary.plain: The Hall A set-up used for PREX: a thin lead target in the electron beam and two high-resolution spectrometers that picked out the electrons scattered elastically at a small angle.
summary.technical: Hall A with its two high-resolution spectrometers measuring elastic scattering of polarised electrons from a 208Pb target (diamond-lead-diamond sandwich in PREX-II) at about 5 degrees; transverse-asymmetry detector and SBS GEM detectors were added in PREX-II.

technology.value: Hall A high-resolution spectrometers with a lead target for parity-violating elastic electron scattering
